title: fix(metadata-protocol): leave a denied audit row for every documented refusal code at the save, publish, rollback and delete doors
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-zhuang"} -->
_Requested by **Sam** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01LjZwNRFiG2fkp8SNf6rHNx?thread=cmsg_01LjZwNRFiG2fkp8SNf6rHNx7AAmZNhrNzszS8chcmhkgm)_
Fixes #28355

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:元数据的保存、发布、回滚、删除四个入口,遇到 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` / `NOT_CREATABLE` / `INVALID_METADATA` / `DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE` 拒绝时,会在 `sys_metadata_audit` 里写一条 `denied` 记录。
- 为什么改:审计表文档一直写着这四个拒绝码,但从没有任何代码写过,读 `/audit` 的人会以为被拒的尝试从未发生。
- 风险与回滚:调用方拿到的错误(码、状态、文案)完全不变;审计写入是尽力而为,失败不影响请求。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-refusal-audit.ts`(映射表与去重标记),`protocol.ts` 四个入口的包装段,`protocol.refusal-audit-rows.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/protocol.refusal-audit-rows.test.ts`,预期 12 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **New module `protocol-refusal-audit.ts`.** A closed map from the four catalogued refusal codes to the lower-case values `sys_metadata_audit.code` already documents (`not_overridable`, `not_creatable`, `invalid_metadata`, `destructive_change`), `refusalAuditEntry` (the row a refusal owes at a door, or none), and `withRefusalAudit` (run the door, record the row on such a refusal, rethrow the same error).
- **The four single-item doors are wrapped.** `saveMetaItem`, `publishMetaItem`, `rollbackMetaItem` and `deleteMetaItem` keep their names and signatures; each is now a short wrapper over a `protected …Unaudited` body holding the unchanged code. The row is written where the door hands the refusal back, so a refusal raised by any gate inside the door (including shared helpers such as the ADR-0131 D6 organization-scoped refusal) is covered, and so is one added later.
- **The row.** `outcome: 'denied'`, `operation` the door, `actor` / `source` as the door's allowed row records them, `note` = `clientFacingFailureText` (the sentence the caller was already shown; the column is wire-visible), and `type` folded to the canonical singular (the writer refuses anything else).
- **What still writes no row.** Any other code (`INVALID_REQUEST`, `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, driver faults, 5xx) writes nothing; the column's set stays closed. `item_locked` and `metadata_conflict` are not in the map, so their own gates' rows are not duplicated. A refusal handed back through two wrapped doors is recorded once (a marker on the error). The batch publish keeps its `batch_aborted` row.
- **Nothing removed from the vocabulary.** All five codes the card lists are refused by a real door; `item_locked` was already stamped (see Acceptance notes), so nothing is trimmed.

## Why

`sys_metadata_audit` promised denial rows that never appeared, so an operator or agent reading `/audit` for a metadata name concluded that a refused authoring attempt never happened. Triage's lean (enforce at the refusing door, beside `metadata_conflict`) is followed.

## Tests

- `protocol.refusal-audit-rows.test.ts` (new, 12 cases), driven through the real doors with a fake engine that persists audit inserts: one denied row per enforced code on the save door (`not_creatable`, `not_overridable`, `destructive_change`, `invalid_metadata`), the plural spelling filed under the canonical type, the publish / rollback / delete doors each stamping their own `operation`, plus an allowed control (one `allowed` / `ok` row, no denied row), an out-of-map refusal (`INVALID_REQUEST`) writing nothing, the closed map, and a refusal through two doors recorded once.
- Five existing pins asserted that a refusal touches the engine not at all, or scanned the door's source by member name. Each is reconciled to the new truth rather than loosened:
  - `protocol.code-only-types.test.ts` (#5264 block), `protocol.lock-org-axis-agree.test.ts`, `protocol.tenant-authored-write.test.ts`: the only engine call a refusal makes is now its own `denied` audit row, asserted exactly (table, operation, code), and still no `sys_metadata` write.
  - `protocol.read-verb-canonical-fold.test.ts`, `protocol.view-expansion-reconcile-call-sites.test.ts`: the fold and the stored-row writes now live in the `…Unaudited` bodies; the rosters name those members (and the method scan admits `protected`, which only these four use).
- `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`: the new test's fake engine is recorded, as `check:engine-double-contract` requires.

## Acceptance notes

- **`item_locked` (the dispatch asked):** it is already stamped. `assertLockAllowsWrite` / `assertLockAllowsDelete` / `lockWriteRefusal` in `protocol-lock-version-gates.ts` write `code: 'item_locked'` with `lock_state` on all four doors, and the batch publish re-records it outside its transaction (`recordPendingDenialAudit`). Not measured: whether the repository's own read-only-base refusal (`SysMetadataRepository.readOnlyBaseOverrideError`, `ITEM_LOCKED` with `lockSource: 'package'`) is ever reached past that gate without a row; it is deliberately not in the map, so a lock-gate refusal cannot be written twice.
- `sys-metadata-audit.object.ts` is unchanged: its documented vocabulary is now true, so no trim was needed.
- One file outside the claimed surface: `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`, the gate's own ledger entry for the new test double.

## Verification

All readings are on head `7e9960c8da` (merged with `origin/main` at `fc5d5093b`), in a dedicated worktree.

- **Package suite:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` (under the verify lock) → `Test Files 285 passed | 4 skipped (289)`, `Tests 21872 passed | 26 skipped (21898)`. Before the five pins were reconciled the same run was 15 red in exactly those five files.
- **Typecheck:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck` → exit 0 (its `tsconfig.json` includes `src/**/*`, so the test files are compiled).
- **Gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 69 commands; all 69 ran and exited 0. `--ran` reconciliation: `69 derived, 69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`, every family carrying its exit code. The two real reds on the first pass were fixed in this PR (`check:objectql-double-limit`: the new `find` double now applies `limit`; `check:engine-double-contract`: the double is recorded in the ledger).
- **Lint:** `pnpm lint` → exit 0.
- `check:platform-checklist` not run: no exported symbol is renamed or removed (the four doors keep their names and signatures).
- Dogfood battery: n/a (no `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm).

<details><summary>Ablation of the audit write (one-off, not kept)</summary>

Predicted before running: the nine denied-row cases red, the allowed control, the `INVALID_REQUEST` no-row case and the closed-map case green.

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-refusal-audit.ts`, anchor `if (entry) {`, replaced by a guard that is always false (`entry && Date.now() is negative`), running `vitest run src/protocol.refusal-audit-rows.test.ts` under it.

- mutation landed: anchor 1 → 0, blob `4b5d1b1c9c20` → `35ebe7c00ab9`
- `Tests 9 failed | 3 passed (12)`, exactly as predicted
- restored: blob after restore `4b5d1b1c9c20` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty

The unit suite imports `./protocol.js` from source, so no rebuild was involved.
</details>
